title: An integrated hardware-software system and iot-driven micro-node architecture for decentralized hyperlocal packet distribution and live inventory synchronization
abstract: A novel decentralized architectural system combining hardware sensors, micro-node edge compute units, and real-time software synchronization for hyperlocal packet routing and live inventory tracking.
highlights: Micro-node edge architecture for real-time inventory updates across distributed fulfillment points.
Decentralized packet routing algorithms optimizing last-mile delivery efficiency.
Hardware-software integration for IoT-enabled logistics tracking.
